text: A non-string JSON field value is an HTML 500 on five authenticated routes

Landed. isinstance guards at the three sites (decode_token, _require_password which covers all five password routes, mint), plus a field-TYPE sweep added to test_request_body.py across every field-reading route using a production-error-handling client. Verified on the fixed build: redeem with an int or dict token is 400 invalid_token JSON, mint with a non-string email is 422 invalid_email, delete-account with a non-string password is 403 invalid_credentials. Side-finding recorded: login's platform has no guard by design.
